claims.text: The dataset was obtained from TripAdvisor hotel reviews, which is the world's largest online travel site.
The dataset, named HotelRec, contains approximately 50 million hotel reviews.
HotelRec includes user profiles, hotel URLs, overall ratings, written text, and dates from the reviews.
